---
name: Standards or methodology alignment
about: Propose or correct an alignment with an external standard, scheme or methodology
title: "[Alignment] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## SDAF version

Identify the SDAF version concerned, for example `1.0`.

## External authority or methodology

Provide:

- organization or publisher;
- complete title;
- version or publication date;
- stable public reference or URL, where available.

## SDAF location

Identify the relevant Part, section, requirement, annex, table or interface.

## Proposed relationship

Select the relationship that best applies:

- [ ] Complementary
- [ ] Partially overlapping
- [ ] SDAF depends on the external authority
- [ ] The external method may supply evidence to SDAF
- [ ] SDAF may operationalize or govern use of the external method
- [ ] Potential conflict or inconsistency
- [ ] Terminology correspondence
- [ ] Interoperability opportunity
- [ ] Other

## Alignment description

Explain the proposed correspondence or difference.

## Authority boundary

Clarify what authority remains with the external standard, scheme, regulator or methodology and what role SDAF performs.

## Gaps or conflicts

Identify differences in:

- scope;
- terminology;
- boundaries;
- evidence requirements;
- measurement method;
- conformance;
- assurance;
- decision authority; or
- versioning.

## Supporting references

Provide clause numbers, public sources or other evidence. Do not reproduce copyrighted material beyond what is necessary and permitted.

## Proposed SDAF treatment

Recommend one or more of the following:

- [ ] Add or revise an alignment entry
- [ ] Add implementation guidance
- [ ] Add an interoperability pattern
- [ ] Clarify an authority boundary
- [ ] Correct terminology
- [ ] Refer for specialist review
- [ ] Consider for a future version

## Independence and endorsement check

- [ ] This proposal does not imply endorsement by the external organization.
- [ ] I have identified any affiliation or potential conflict of interest.
- [ ] I have identified relevant licensing or quotation restrictions.

## Submission checks

- [ ] I searched existing issues and alignment material.
- [ ] I identified the relevant versions of both SDAF and the external source.
- [ ] I distinguished evidence from interpretation.
- [ ] I have not included confidential or restricted material.
